causal_scale.definition: A platform explicitly says it banned or removed accounts referenced or flagged in a Graphika report.
causal_scale.label: direct report-to-enforcement

causal_scale.definition: Graphika was a named coalition member or coauthor; coalition analysts flagged or reported content and later documented platform action, but individual causal attribution to Graphika is not available.
causal_scale.label: coalition flag-to-platform action

causal_scale.definition: Graphika-linked coalitions publicly named accounts/outlets or recommended labels, probation, sanctions, removal, or account/community-level enforcement without proof of a specific resulting action.
causal_scale.label: target identification or enforcement advocacy

data.finding: Direct platform authority is not established. Moderation-pipeline participation is established: Graphika worked inside EIP and the Virality Project, whose analysts generated tickets or flags, identified people and outlets, recommended sanctions, and recorded labels, removals, downranking, suspensions, and bans. The strongest direct sequence is Graphika identifying deceptive Spamouflage accounts and TikTok stating that accounts referenced in the report were banned.

moderation_cases.case: Spamouflage accounts posing as U.S. voters
moderation_cases.graphika_role: Graphika identified and reported the deceptive cluster.
moderation_cases.limit: This concerned coordinated deceptive personas attributed to a foreign influence operation, not ordinary disclosed domestic speakers.
moderation_cases.platform_outcome: TikTok stated that accounts referenced in the Graphika report were banned; related YouTube and Instagram assets had also been taken down.

moderation_cases.graphika_role: Graphika was a core Election Integrity Partnership member; the EIP investigated and reported the spread.
moderation_cases.limit: The source does not isolate which partner submitted which evidence or prove a particular takedown was caused by Graphika.
moderation_cases.platform_outcome: The EIP observed labels or takedowns by Facebook and TikTok.
targets: cross-platform posts on Reddit, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and Twitter

moderation_cases.graphika_role: Two Graphika analysts coauthored the Virality Project report; Virality Project analysts flagged the video.
moderation_cases.limit: The report establishes flagging followed by removal, but does not state Instagram removed it because of that flag.
moderation_cases.platform_outcome: The 360,000-view video had been removed by Instagram when the report was published; related posts received warning labels.
targets: an Instagram video from a holistic women's-health advocate

moderation_cases.case: VAERS TikTok video and named vaccine critics
moderation_cases.graphika_role: A Graphika analyst coauthored the Virality Project analysis.
moderation_cases.limit: No evidence in the page establishes that the Virality Project or Graphika caused the removal or caused enforcement against the named entities.
moderation_cases.platform_outcome: The report noted the TikTok video had been removed and profiled the named accounts/groups as recurring sources.

moderation_cases.graphika_role: The EIP, of which Graphika was a core member, categorized these outlets/accounts as repeat spreaders.
moderation_cases.limit: The recommendation is evidence of enforcement advocacy, not proof the named entities were sanctioned because of Graphika.
moderation_cases.platform_outcome: The EIP recommended stronger sanctions, account labels, probation, monitoring, and potentially removal.

moderation_cases.graphika_role: The Virality Project coalition included Graphika, though the specific article was authored by University of Washington researchers.
moderation_cases.limit: This is coalition-level policy advocacy, not an individually attributable Graphika recommendation.
moderation_cases.platform_outcome: The article recommended that moderation expand beyond individual content to the accounts and communities creating avoidance strategies.
targets: vaccine-opposed accounts and communities using moderation-avoidance tactics

summary: Graphika did not generally exercise platform enforcement authority itself, but it participated in coalitions that flagged content, named repeat spreaders, recommended sanctions, and documented platform labels, removals, downranking, and bans; a direct Graphika-report-to-ban sequence is documented for a deceptive Spamouflage cluster.
title: Graphika moderation pipeline and complete award reconciliation
